Pilot (RULES 16) of the issue's twelve arms on classes-18; ctl is the specimen's shipped configuration (every
kit switch 0). Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's borg_param_* values present in the applied borg.txt

settings (the issue states the smoke suite is unchanged).

for deaths in kit or all that ctl survives. Each tested value gets a RULES 18 bin (harmful, neutral, helpful).
An 18-game pilot sizes nothing: no claim of improvement from it (RULES 8). The issue's local replays (8 of 17
base deaths survive under leash/kit/c, but a C flow_leash_base control rescues 13 of 17) are not a result.
Not run: town_hunt=1 and borg_money_scum_amount as other ways to money (the issue lists them "if capacity
allows", with no value for the scum amount); they need an owner-set value and their own arms.
